Definition: Lemek, the name of two antediluvian patriarchs
BiblicalUsage: Lamech = "powerful"; 1) the 5th lineal descendant from Cain, husband of Adah and Zillah, father of sons, Jabal, Jubal, and Tubal-cain, and daughter, Naamah; 2) father of Noah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
